title: BrowserStack Demo – Functional Validation for Training & Demo
description:
h2. Objective

Validate the core e-commerce functionalities of the BrowserStack Demo application to support the upcoming training and demo session.

h2. Environment

*Application:* BrowserStack Demo

*URL:* [https://bstackdemo.com/|https://bstackdemo.com/|smart-link] 

*Username:* {{demouser}}

*Password:* {{testingisfun99}} _(Select these values from the Username and Password dropdowns on the Sign In page.)_

----

h2. Scenario 1: Login to the Application

h3. Acceptance Criteria

* User can navigate to the application.
* User can access the Sign In page.
* User can log in using valid demo credentials.
* User name is displayed after successful login.
* No authentication errors are displayed.

----

h2. Scenario 2: Search and Filter Products

h3. Acceptance Criteria

* User can search for a product using the search functionality.
* User can filter products by brand.
* Filtered products are displayed correctly.
* Search and filter results are updated without page errors.
* Product details remain accessible after filtering.

----

h2. Scenario 3: Add Product to Shopping Cart

h3. Acceptance Criteria

* User can select any available product.
* User can add the selected product to the cart.
* Cart icon updates with the correct item count.
* Added product appears in the shopping cart.
* Product price and quantity are displayed correctly.
